theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the sole eligible trend-extension leader with the highest durability bar (0.52) and a clean 'trend' Hurst tag, so the absolute-trend gate — the one leg with historical drawdown merit in other markets — is the only leg that would permit a directional lean here. However, gate_helps=false on China A-shares specifically and crowding_z=1.74 (crowded=true) means this is a de-risk, not a chase.
theses.dissent: The trend gate whipsaws on this mean-reverting tape (backtest_verdict: absolute_trend_gate did_NOT_hold_here), and the crowded flag plus one_narrative concentration historically marks late-stage leadership — a drawdown from a crowded single theme is exactly what the gate fails to filter here.
